## What the split does NOT decide

- The DF-S1.2-2 / DF-S1.5-3 `e2-replay` cells: they need an e2-tree arm extension that is out of
  scope for this chain (operator-visible separate change per the contract's item-3/§5 convention).
  R4.4b either lands clean DONEs (if the E3-leg evidence plus the recorded e2-pending cell meets
  the rows' verification cells) or surfaces the exact unmet cell — pause/ask, recorded, never a
  silent deferral.
- CF-493 vocabulary: unchanged; GATE-G7 (row 164a) rules it.
